# Francis Phiri

> Data Engineer, Software Developer and Machine Learning Researcher based in Johannesburg, South Africa. Junior Data Engineer at KHM Technology; MSc from the University of the Witwatersrand; peer-reviewed publications at SATNAC 2024 (Second-Best Paper Award) and IEEE GLOBECOM 2025.

Francis Phiri builds data platforms, intelligent software and research-driven technology across data engineering, software development and applied machine learning — with active research in 5G/6G edge intelligence, deep reinforcement learning and federated learning.
